ordered_diagnoses: Severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2) infection

facts.raw_span: A 41-year-old woman
originally from Sierra Leone, living in Boston
SARS-CoV-2 infection 2 weeks prior with anosmia and cough lasting 4 days
developed fever, headache, and malaise. Three days before presentation
malaria as a child
Temperature: 39.4˚C
Regular tachycardia
Platelet count: 90 × 10⁹/L (thrombocytopenia)
Thick blood smear: Plasmodium species present
Rapid diagnostic testing (Abbot BinaxNOW): positive for T1 (histidine-rich protein 2) and T2 (aldolase) antigens
Peripheral blood smear: 3.5% parasitemia
Delicate ring forms (trophozoites) and a multiply infected erythrocyte with appliqué forms, 1000× magnification
